lines.zh: 我不再踱步，我直接过来。
lines.en: I don't pace anymore; I come straight over.

lines.zh: 我的移动比上一阶段更顺。
lines.en: My movement flows better than before.

lines.zh: 每一步都更近，没有停顿。
lines.en: Every step is closer, with no pause.
I cross the threshold without going around.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯跟着我的方向灭。
lines.en: The corridor lights go out along my path.
I no longer keep to the wall.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留下暗痕。
lines.en: A dark streak stays where I step.
I come at you from the front.
The gap is down to one tile.
I stand straight and watch you.
My face is clearer than before.

lines.zh: 你眨了几次眼，我一次都没有。
lines.en: You blink several times. I never do.
I'm waiting to see what you'll do.
Every sound in the room is gone.
My shadow is completely still.

lines.zh: 门缝里露着我的半张脸，别回头。
lines.en: Half my face shows in the door gap. Don't turn.

lines.zh: 我站得像一张定格的照片。
lines.en: I stand like a frozen photograph.
Your eyes are very wide.
My hands hang quietly.

lines.zh: 我不再是画面里的东西。
lines.en: I'm not something in a picture anymore.

lines.zh: 我们之间什么都没发生。
lines.en: Nothing at all is happening between us.
I lean forward slightly.
You haven't run.

lines.zh: 钟停了，我还在你身后站着。
lines.en: The clock stopped; I still stand behind you.
I'm waiting for you to blink.
Now you can see it more clearly.
The last phase was nothing.
You still haven't moved at all.
In phase two, I stare harder.
You've backed into the corner.
I want you to face me.
You're calculating the distance.
The lights won't stay on.
You can hear your own heart.
We can talk without words.
Turn, and I turn with you.
I'm more used to the dark than you.
This room has no window.

lines.zh: 你手上没有能用的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing useful in your hands.
My shape split for a moment.
That pushed me back half a tile.
I've blurred a little again.
You did touch something.
I shouldn't have come this close.
A bit of my face is missing.
I realign myself.
This body could come apart any moment.

lines.zh: 你打过来时，我发现你的手在抖。
lines.en: When you strike, I notice your hand trembling.
I'm still here, watching you.
Don't hold things up in front of me.
Put it down, and keep your eyes on me.
I don't live on that.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西救不了你。
lines.en: That won't save you.

lines.zh: 食物收好，我闻的是你的恐惧。
lines.en: Put the food away; it is your fear I smell.

lines.zh: 跟踪第二阶段的影子不缺什么。
lines.en: The stalking phase-two shadow lacks nothing.
What else would you trade?
I look at it, then back at you.
You want that more than I do.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，感觉像撞进空处。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting empty space.
I neither retreat nor give way.

lines.zh: 你整个身子都贴到我了。
lines.en: Your whole body is against me now.
My touch is light, and cold.
You push; I stand like a wall.
That one bounces you back.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近，看不到脸。
lines.en: Too close to see a face now.

lines.zh: 你的脚退不了，后面是墙。
lines.en: You can't back up; the wall is there.
I didn't let you past.
There's only me in this phase.
The other one stays a phase behind.
It won't catch up now.
We take turns appearing here.
It does this more slowly.

lines.zh: 我们不会同时在画面里。
lines.en: We're never in the frame at once.
It's behind you; I'm here.
We don't communicate.
It has given its place to me.
Only one shadow is left in this room.
I don't need hands to take it.

lines.zh: 东西掉在地上，我只看你弯腰。
lines.en: It fell on the floor; I just watch you bend.
It rolls to my position by itself.

lines.zh: 那件东西留在地上，我朝你走。
lines.en: The thing stays on the floor. I walk to you.

lines.zh: 这点东西改变不了什么。
lines.en: That won't change anything.

lines.zh: 你在找东西的时候，我就在这。
lines.en: While you search, I'm right here.
I won't interrupt you.
It never left where it was.
It isn't the point.
Did you hear it drop?
I don't have to go slowly anymore.
Now I'm in front of you.
This room has no other way out.

lines.zh: 我看你，你已经看回来了。
lines.en: I look at you, and you're looking back.
Distance doesn't matter now.

lines.zh: 跟踪的第二阶段，就长这样。
lines.en: This is what stalking phase two looks like.
I don't need your peripheral vision anymore.
I'm standing where you'd run.
Your choices just got one fewer.
Phase two; I stop hiding.
The lights have all gone out.
I'm here, very close.
Your eyes are still open.
Just keep watching now.
I don't need to circle anymore.
You back away; I'm always ahead.
You can't shake me off.

lines.zh: 你每喘一口，我的脸就更清楚。
lines.en: With every breath, my face grows clearer.

lines.zh: 我听得见你每一个动作。
lines.en: I hear every movement you make.
You don't dare look away.
You've started counting the seconds.
I can wait all night.
I know the paths on this level.
You turn the corner, and I'm already there.
The more afraid you are, the slower you go.
I stay directly in front.
I'm in the middle of your sight.
You've started to shake.
One stretch of corridor left.
I stand at the end of it.
Your footsteps are getting lighter.
I take your arm.
This time I see it clearly.
You're pulled half a step closer.
I press against your chest.
Your warmth is dropping.
You can't pull free of this.
You didn't cry out.
I let go, and you're still standing.
You're barely moving now.
That brought us closer.
My movement wasn't wrong.
Your eyes are half closed.

lines.zh: 我从上一阶段走出来了。
lines.en: I've stepped out of the previous phase.
This face is more complete now.
I'm no longer a blurred shape.
The lights all die, and I'm here.
I stand in the middle of the corridor.
I'm only a few paces from the door.
My shadow has edges now.
Listen — the footsteps have stopped.
I open my eyes and look right at you.

lines.zh: 这是第二次，也是最后一次。
lines.en: This is the second time. And the last.
The light has drained from the walls.

lines.zh: 我站在你能看清的距离。
lines.en: I stand at a distance you can see me from.
I wait without moving.
The room has gotten smaller.
I face you, straight on.
There's nowhere left to hide.
We're both standing still.
The firelight scrambles my outline.

lines.zh: 我落下去，地面上没有印。
lines.en: I fall, and leave no mark on the floor.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我从中间散开。
lines.en: Water floods in and I come apart in the middle.
The blast drives me back into the wall.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，带走一部分。
lines.en: Something passes through and takes part of me.
Light pins me and I can't move.
I have no stomach, and no hunger.

lines.zh: 雷光照得我几乎看不见。
lines.en: The flash nearly washes me out.

lines.zh: 这里没有墙可以投影子。
lines.en: There's no wall here to cast a shadow on.
